activityPlan.introSummary: Based on your current weight (69 kg, BMI 21.3), here's a personalized, beginner-safe weekly activity plan to help you build functional fitness and stamina.

schedule.focusTitle: Morning Tempo Brisk Walk & Core Warmup

routine.name: Brisk Cadence Walking & Light Jog Intervals
routine.description: Comfortable steady-paced walking with 30-second light jog intervals every 5 minutes.
routine.warmup: 2 minutes of ankle circles, hip openers, and slow gentle pacing.
routine.cooldown: 3 minutes of slow walking and standing calf/quad stretches.
routine.safetyTip: Maintain upright posture; avoid leaning forward to minimize lower back pressure.

routine.name: Standing Core & Pelvic Alignment
routine.description: Controlled standing pelvic tilts, abdominal bracing, and gentle high-knee march holds.
routine.equipmentNeeded: None (wall or chair for light balance support)
routine.warmup: Side-to-side gentle torso rotations.
routine.cooldown: Slow deep diaphragm breathing.
routine.safetyTip: Engage core gently without holding your breath.

schedule.wellnessNote: Hydrate with at least 500ml of water throughout the morning.

routine.name: Bodyweight Air Squats & Incline Push-Ups
routine.description: 3 sets of 12 full air squats + 10 incline push-ups + 20-second plank hold.
routine.warmup: Arm swings and unweighted knee lifts for 2 minutes.
routine.cooldown: Seated hamstring stretch and chest opening stretch.
routine.safetyTip: Ensure knees stay aligned over your second toe; do not let knees collapse inward.

routine.name: Glute Bridges & Seated Spinal Twist
routine.description: Lying on a soft yoga mat, press through heels to raise hips into bridge (2 sets of 10 reps), followed by seated spine twists.
routine.warmup: Cat-Cow stretch on hands and knees.
routine.cooldown: Child’s pose hold for 60 seconds.
routine.safetyTip: Squeeze glutes at the top of the bridge without arching your lower back excessively.

schedule.wellnessNote: Muscle recovery takes 24-48 hours; prioritize quality protein at lunch.

routine.name: Gentle Restorative Flow & Neck/Shoulder Release
routine.description: A soothing sequence of neck rolls, shoulder shrugs, seated side bends, and 10 minutes of easy strolling outdoors.
routine.warmup: Deep diaphragmatic breathing in a comfortable seated position.
routine.cooldown: Lying supine hamstring stretch with towel support.
routine.safetyTip: Never bounce in a stretch; hold each position gently for 20-30 seconds.

schedule.wellnessNote: Rest days allow muscle tissue to rebuild stronger and reduce cortisol levels.

routine.name: Brisk Outdoor Cycling or Incline Walk
routine.description: Moderate paced cycling on flat/rolling terrain or a 3-degree treadmill incline walk.
routine.equipmentNeeded: Stationary bike, outdoor cycle, or walking path
routine.warmup: 3 minutes of zero-resistance gentle pedaling or casual walking.
routine.cooldown: 2 minutes of easy pacing and standing quad stretches.
routine.safetyTip: Adjust saddle height so your knee has a slight 10-15 degree bend at the bottom of the stroke.

routine.name: Standing Calf Raises & Ankle Mobility
routine.description: 2 sets of 12 controlled calf raises standing on flat ground, holding a counter for balance.
routine.warmup: Ankle rotations.
routine.cooldown: Calf stretch against the wall.
routine.safetyTip: Raise and lower on a 2-second count for maximum tendon adaptation.

schedule.wellnessNote: Endurance workouts boost capillary density and mitochondria function.

routine.name: Doorframe Rows, Push-Ups & Step-Ups
routine.description: 3 rounds of 10 doorframe rows, 8 push-ups, and 10 alternating step-ups on a sturdy step.
routine.equipmentNeeded: Light resistance band or two 1-liter water bottles
routine.warmup: Arm circles and torso twists for 2 minutes.
routine.cooldown: Chest doorway stretch and upper back stretch.
routine.safetyTip: Keep shoulders pulled down and back away from your ears.

routine.name: Core Bracing & Deadbugs
routine.description: Lying on back, alternate extending opposite arm and leg while pressing lower back flat into the floor (2 sets of 8 reps per side).
routine.warmup: Pelvic tilts.
routine.cooldown: Full body pencil stretch on mat.
routine.safetyTip: If your lower back arches off the mat, reduce the range of motion of your legs.

schedule.wellnessNote: Consistent core strength prevents lower back fatigue during daily work.

schedule.focusTitle: Eco-Commute Nature Walk or Green Exploration

routine.name: Nature Trail Walk / Low-Carbon Transit Stroll
routine.description: Continuous relaxed outdoor walk in a local park, greenway, or walking errand, taking in natural sunlight and fresh air.
routine.warmup: 3 minutes of slow pacing.
routine.cooldown: Gentle standing quad and hamstring stretches.
routine.safetyTip: Stay on established paths and wear sunscreen for outdoor sessions.

schedule.wellnessNote: Exercising in green outdoor spaces reduces stress biomarkers by up to 28%.

schedule.focusTitle: Full Body Restorative Yoga & Sleep Prep

routine.name: Gentle Evening Yoga & Diaphragmatic Breathwork
routine.description: Gentle seated forward fold, butterfly pose, legs-up-the-wall pose (5 minutes), and 5 minutes of 4-7-8 relaxing breathing.
routine.warmup: Gentle neck and shoulder rolls.
routine.cooldown: Savasana relaxation pose.
routine.safetyTip: Focus on slow nasal breathing; allow muscles to release without tension.

schedule.wellnessNote: Good sleep tonight establishes positive metabolic rhythm for the coming week.
